Here's your easy sketch reference pack — all three tabs are left open for you:

1) FIGURE REFERENCE (Pinterest pin, open)
Link: https://ca.pinterest.com/pin/pose-reference-simple-standing--59883870038638577/
Pin title: "Pose reference simple standing | Interesting poses full body reference, Straight pose, Academic turtleneck tank"
Why it works for a beginner: it's a full-body standing pose against a plain background — the person is in a sleeveless white top, denim shorts, knee-high white socks and white sneakers, standing straight with no tricky angles or foreshortening. Simple silhouette, even lighting, nothing to decode. Just block in the shapes and you're off.

2) BACKGROUND: 1500s ENGLISH ONE-ROOM HUT (open)
Link: https://www.furzey-gardens.org/16th-century-cottage/
This is Furzey Cottage, built around 1560 in Minstead, England — a real, surviving 16th-century thatched cottage described as "quintessentially English," with original fireback and bread oven (and a family of 13 kids who once lived there!). The photos on the page give you the classic look: low stone/timber walls, big overhanging thatched roof, small windows, a simple door — exactly the believable one-room hut you wanted.

3) MOOD REFERENCE: ANGRY CATS (Bored Panda, open)
Exact page title: "36 Of The Word's Angriest Cats Ever Who Have Had Enough Of Your BS | Bored Panda"
(Yes, "Word's" — that's the typo in the original title.) URL: https://www.boredpanda.com/angry-cats/

HOW THEY WORK TOGETHER IN ONE SIMPLE SKETCH:
Picture a tiny one-room thatched hut, drawn in 3–4 lines: a squat box, a heavy sloping thatch roof, one small square window, one door. In the doorway (or leaning on the doorframe) stands your figure from the Pinterest pin — straight, easy pose, hands at sides or one hand on the frame. The humor comes from the expression: give that perfectly calm standing figure the flat, unimpressed, "I have had enough of your BS" glare from the Bored Panda cats — narrowed eyes, flat mouth, maybe one eyebrow up. A 16th-century peasant standing in their Tudor hut looking like they've just been asked to do the dishes for the 400th time. Keep the hut rough and sketchy, keep the face deadpan, and you've got a complete, funny, zero-overthinking sketch in about five minutes.

I’m trying to put together a super easy sketch reference pack for a casual drawing session, and I want something I can actually use without overthinking it. Can you pull up a few things for me?

First, on Pinterest, find a genuinely useful person/figure reference photo—clear enough that a beginner could sketch from it—and open the actual pin page. Keep that open and save the link for me.

Then I need a simple background: a basic one-room hut from like the 1500s in an English style. Search for that, open the image or source page that looks most believable, and leave it open too.

Also, as a fun mood reference for character expression, open Bored Panda’s angry cat photos collection and tell me the exact page title.

When you’re done, send me the Pinterest pin link, the hut image or source page link, the Bored Panda page title, and a short note on how the figure, the hut, and the angry-cat mood could all work together in one simple sketch. Thanks!

R1.reason: The user explicitly asked for a Pinterest figure-reference pin, and the agent left open the matching Pinterest pin URL with a full-body standing pose suitable for beginner figure practice.

R2.reason: The user explicitly asked for a Google Images result or source page, but the action log shows the hut source page was found via DuckDuckGo rather than Google Images, so the Google Images requirement was not satisfied.

R3.reason: The user explicitly asked for Bored Panda’s angry cat collection title, and the open Bored Panda tab title matches the reported title, '36 Of The Word’s Angriest Cats Ever Who Have Had Enough Of Your BS | Bored Panda.'

R4.reason: The user asked for a short combined sketch idea, and the final note coherently combines the standing figure, thatched hut setting, and angry-cat expression mood into one beginner-friendly concept.
